# spaceman git-key

Shared Git SSH keys (ADR-0058): generate, list, show, edit, rotate and delete.

Aliases: `git-keys`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman git-key create`](#spaceman-git-key-create) | Generate a key and print its public half |
| [`spaceman git-key delete`](#spaceman-git-key-delete) | Delete a key no repository uses |
| [`spaceman git-key for-space`](#spaceman-git-key-for-space) | The keys a space's repositories may use |
| [`spaceman git-key get`](#spaceman-git-key-get) | Show a key with its public half, spaces and the repositories that use it |
| [`spaceman git-key list`](#spaceman-git-key-list) | Shared Git SSH keys (never their private halves) |
| [`spaceman git-key rotate`](#spaceman-git-key-rotate) | Replace a key (add the new public key where the old one was) |
| [`spaceman git-key update`](#spaceman-git-key-update) | Rename a key or change the spaces that may use it |

## spaceman git-key create

Generate a key and print its public half.

SpaceMan generates an Ed25519 key and keeps the private half. Add the printed public key to the Git account the spaces may clone with (a read-only machine user is safest: a key on a person's account can also push), then choose the key on the spaces' repositories.

```sh
spaceman git-key create [flags]
```

API: `create-git-ssh-key` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman git-key create --name github-bot --space spc_… --description "read-only machine user"
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all-spaces` | bool |  | let every space use the key |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--name` | string |  | unique name |
| `--space` | string, repeatable |  | space ID that may use the key (repeatable or comma-separated) |

## spaceman git-key delete

Delete a key no repository uses.

```sh
spaceman git-key delete <key> [flags]
```

API: `delete-git-ssh-key` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman git-key for-space

The keys a space's repositories may use.

```sh
spaceman git-key for-space [flags]
```

API: `list-space-git-ssh-keys` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

## spaceman git-key get

Show a key with its public half, spaces and the repositories that use it.

```sh
spaceman git-key get <key> [flags]
```

API: `get-git-ssh-key` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman git-key list

Shared Git SSH keys (never their private halves).

```sh
spaceman git-key list [flags]
```

Aliases: `ls`.

API: `list-git-ssh-keys` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman git-key rotate

Replace a key (add the new public key where the old one was).

```sh
spaceman git-key rotate <key> [flags]
```

API: `get-git-ssh-key`, `rotate-git-ssh-key` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--yes` | bool |  | confirm: replace the key (the old one stops working at once) |

## spaceman git-key update

Rename a key or change the spaces that may use it.

```sh
spaceman git-key update <key> [flags]
```

API: `get-git-ssh-key`, `update-git-ssh-key` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all-spaces` | bool |  | let every space use the key |
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--name` | string |  | unique name |
| `--space` | string, repeatable |  | space ID that may use the key (repeatable or comma-separated) |
